channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: The Uplift: Hot ones
item.description: Vladimir Duthiers interviews Sean Evans, host of "Hot Ones," where celebrities answer questions while eating spicy chicken wings.

item.title: Senate passes funding bill to keep government running through December
item.description: The bill passed with a 90-6 vote and now moves to the House for consideration.

item.title: Child among four killed in Russian strikes on Ukraine
item.description: Debris from the attacks caused multiple fires near Kyiv, with at least four fatalities reported.

item.title: Russian strikes on Kyiv region kill four, including a child
item.description: The attacks on Kyiv and its outskirts resulted in four deaths, one of which was a child.
